purpose: Test one predeclared risk variant for Signal A, create forward tracking series for Signal B, calibrate forward review rules, and measure OOS dependence between B and the frozen MGC volatility-breakout sleeve.
prohibitions: No parameter change after the git commit containing this file.
No full-sample aggregate may be used as a selection, acceptance, or abandonment criterion.
IS and OOS must always be reported separately.
No threshold optimization, parameter search, alternative stop, or filtered-performance search is permitted.
Micros are robustness evidence only and cannot select the Signal A variant.

precommit_audit_disclosure.detail: During code/source discovery, the CSV header and first two 2024 trade records of the already-frozen MGC volatility-breakout sleeve were displayed before this spec was committed. No aggregate PnL, correlation, overlap statistic, Signal A result, or Signal B result was computed or inspected.
precommit_audit_disclosure.mitigation: All decision thresholds below are generic, fixed here before computation, and the previewed individual records are not used in any rule or choice. The phase2 report must repeat this disclosure.

correlation_common_OOS.policy: Use the intersection of available sessions for B and the frozen MGC volatility-breakout replay within these inclusive dates.

risk_unit.definition: net or gross trade PnL USD divided by prior completed session Wilder daily ATR(14) in price units times contract point value
risk_unit.missing_policy: Exclude a trade from R statistics when the lagged daily ATR is unavailable; retain it in USD counts and report the excluded count.

signal_and_execution.entry: next 5-minute bar open after the completed observation window
signal_and_execution.costs: Use the repository instrument tick value and USD 1.25 commission per side with one adverse tick of slippage per side, exactly as in the canonical backtest.

A0.stop_rule: Existing canonical stop distance is max(abs(entry_price - previous_close_target), causal intraday ATR on the completed signal bar).
A0.other_exits: Target, maximum holding time, and session-end behavior unchanged.

A_stop.stop_rule: Replace the canonical stop with a fixed stop whose distance from entry equals abs(entry_price - previous_close_target). Long stop = entry - distance; short stop = entry + distance.
A_stop.other_exits: Target, maximum holding time, session-end behavior, costs, entries, and non-overlap policy unchanged.
A_stop.same_bar_policy: If stop and target are both touched in the same 5-minute bar, book the stop first.

signal_A.evaluation_population: All canonical N>=0.25 trades, assigned once to exclusive buckets [0.25,0.50), [0.50,0.75), [0.75,1.00), >=1.00. Primary variant decision uses NQ pooled across these exclusive buckets; bucket results are descriptive.

metrics.trade_CVaR5_loss_R: Positive loss magnitude: minus the arithmetic mean of the smallest ceil(0.05*n) net_R trades.
metrics.max_drawdown_loss_R: Positive loss magnitude: minus the minimum drawdown of cumulative daily net_R, after summing trades by session date and zero-filling business days inside the period.
metrics.expectancy_R: Arithmetic mean net_R per valid trade.

predeclared_decision.IS_risk_gate: A_stop passes IS only if both trade_CVaR5_loss_R and max_drawdown_loss_R are strictly lower than A0 on NQ IS.
predeclared_decision.OOS_non_degradation_gate: A_stop passes OOS if mean_net_R(A_stop) - mean_net_R(A0) >= -0.25 * abs(mean_net_R(A0)) on NQ OOS. For a positive A0 this is equivalent to retaining at least 75% of A0 expectancy.
predeclared_decision.retained_forward_variant: Use A_stop only if it passes both the IS risk gate and the OOS non-degradation gate; otherwise retain A0.
predeclared_decision.micros: Report the same metrics for MES, MNQ, and M2K separately as robustness only; they cannot change the retained variant.

canonical.rvol_definition: current MGC bar volume divided by median volume at the same ET slot over the prior 20 sessions
canonical.confirmation: A climax bar is followed by an opposite-direction confirmation bar; enter at the next bar open.

forward_series.B_no_volume: Identical price threshold, confirmation, entry, holding period, session, costs and non-overlap policy, but set the rvol threshold to zero. Preserve the canonical 20-prior-session feature warm-up so both series share the same availability convention.

signal_B.selection_policy: No B rule variant is selected. Both ledgers are tracking series; their difference measures the contribution of the volume condition.

power.alternative: mean net_R equals the observed OOS mean
power.eligibility: Compute finite N only when OOS mean net_R > 0 and at least two valid OOS trades exist; otherwise report N as undefined because OOS supplies no positive edge to power against zero.

review.timing: One review when N completed forward trades is first reached, separately for each series.
review.interpretation: One-sided 10% rejection of persistence of the OOS edge. No repeated-review alpha spending because only the first N-trade review is permitted.

kill_switch.rule: Cumulative net_R of trades closed in the trailing 365 calendar days is strictly negative.
kill_switch.evaluation_clock: Evaluate after every completed forward trade, but only after 365 calendar days have elapsed since that series' forward start.
kill_switch.effect: Stop the tracking/deployment series; do not alter or re-optimize parameters.

volatility_sleeve_parameters.source: Use the frozen spec and one-minute replay named in data_locks; no modification.

daily_pnl.primary: Pearson correlation of daily net PnL USD after summing each sleeve by session_date and zero-filling every weekday in the common OOS interval.
secondary: Spearman correlation on the same zero-filled daily series
Pearson correlation restricted to days when at least one sleeve trades

event_overlap.same_session: Count a trade as same-session overlap when both sleeves have at least one entry on the same session_date; report the count divided separately by each sleeve's number of active sessions.
event_overlap.position_time: For each B trade, flag overlap if its half-open [entry_time, exit_time) interval intersects any volatility-sleeve interval on the same session; report the rate over B trades. Also report the reciprocal rate over volatility trades.

decision.separate_sleeve: Classify as a separate sleeve if abs(primary Pearson) < 0.30, B same-session overlap < 25%, volatility same-session overlap < 25%, and B position-time overlap < 25%.
decision.filter_only: Classify as filter-only candidate if primary Pearson >= 0.50, or B same-session overlap >= 50%, or B position-time overlap >= 50%.
decision.otherwise: Classify as inconclusive/complementary diagnostic; do not force either role.
decision.no_filtered_performance: Do not calculate performance of one signal conditioned on the other.

report_contract.first_line: The git commit hash containing this frozen spec.
required_sections: B canonical and no-volume OOS tracking distributions
forward N, thresholds and kill-switch protocol
B versus MGC volatility-breakout OOS correlation and overlap
